name: C11_PI_TREEWIDTH2_OR_LIST3_TERMINAL_GATE_V1

forest_terminal.role: Retained authority; subsumed by tw<=2 terminal for the new gate.

frozen_terminal_stack.input: For each authoritative C11 survivor pair and each PI assignment (gamma,delta) in {3,4}^2, after exact frozen propagation/preprocessing and connected-component decomposition, classify every surviving connected component C with exact current lists.

case_0.label: CONTRADICTION
case_0.condition: Exact frozen propagation produces empty list, improper fixed edge, or another already-authorized contradiction certificate.

case_1.label: L3_READY
case_1.condition: There exists a color c in [4] absent from every list in C.

case_2.label: TW2_LIST_READY
case_2.condition: No global missing color is required; graph C has treewidth at most 2.
case_2.recognition: Use a polynomial/fixed-k treewidth-2 recognition/decomposition algorithm.
case_2.positive_certificate: Verified tree decomposition of width at most 2.
case_2.state_bound: At most 4^3=64 raw color assignments per width-2 bag.

case_3.label: K4_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL
case_3.condition: C is connected, noncontradictory, not L3_READY, and tw(C)>2.

universal_target: Determine whether every authoritative C11 PI residual component is terminal by CONTRADICTION, L3_READY, or TW2_LIST_READY.
exact_algorithm_if_universal: For each survivor pair and each of four PI assignments, perform only frozen exact propagation/preprocessing.
Factor the remaining undecided induced graph into connected components with all fixed-boundary restrictions encoded in lists.
For each component test global missing color; if yes, call List-3.
Otherwise run treewidth<=2 recognition/decomposition; if yes, verify the decomposition and run the exact four-color list-DP.
Reconstruct branch colorings and therefore q_{gamma,delta}.
Repeat for all four assignments and all polynomially enumerable survivor pairs.
Account for polynomial recognition, decomposition verification, DP, reconstruction, and total n^2-pair budget.

W1_UNIVERSAL_LIST3_OR_TW2_COLLAPSE.label: W1_UNIVERSAL_LIST3_OR_TW2_COLLAPSE
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying argument from frozen authoritative-core hypotheses that every residual component terminates in CONTRADICTION, L3_READY, or TW2_LIST_READY.
A polynomial graph-only procedure recognizing/finding the width-2 decomposition when applicable.
Exact list-DP and reconstruction for TW2 components.
Exact polynomial accounting for all four PI bits across all authoritative pairs.
No extension oracle and no general P7-free 4-coloring oracle.
consequence_ceiling: All four PI bits become polynomially computable.
D1_PI_POLY_DISCOVERABLE may be promoted with an exact binding receipt.
The <=16 Pi-mask quotient becomes polynomially discoverable.
P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT may be promoted only with a separate exact binding receipt.

W2_K4_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL.label: W2_K4_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL
W2_K4_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL.condition: A concrete authoritative residual component C survives frozen preprocessing, has no global missing color, and has treewidth greater than 2.
certificate: exact propagated connected residual graph C
four pairwise-disjoint nonempty connected branch sets B1,B2,B3,B4
for every unordered pair Bi,Bj, an explicit graph edge with one endpoint in Bi and one in Bj
independent verification that the branch sets form a K4-minor model
W2_K4_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL.interpretation: Establishes only existence of an authoritative residual outside the current {List-3, tw<=2 arbitrary-list} terminal union.

W3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: W3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
W3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither universal W1 authority nor a complete authoritative W2 certificate is obtained.
W3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.interpretation: No mathematical negation beyond unresolved status.

positive_control.source: Previously sealed authoritative T2 C4 residual.
positive_control.interpretation: The old cyclic T2 witness must not survive as W2.

negative_classifier_control.purpose: Verify the negative side recognizes and checks an actual K4-minor certificate rather than treating any cyclic graph as tw>2.

branch_sets_requirements: Each induced branch-set subgraph is connected.
K4_minor_certificate_verifier.pairwise_adjacency_requirement: For each of the six unordered pairs {i,j}, provide at least one original graph edge joining Bi to Bj.
K4_minor_certificate_verifier.consequence: Contracting each branch set yields K4 as a minor, certifying tw(C)>2.

anti_cheat: Failure of a heuristic treewidth/decomposition search is not W2.
W2 requires an explicit K4-minor model.
A cycle alone does not imply tw>2.
The previous C4 T2 witness is a positive TW2 control, not W2.
Finite enumeration alone cannot establish universal W1.
Do not use a general P7-free 4-coloring/list-4 oracle.
Do not infer unbounded treewidth from one K4-minor witness.
forbidden: branching search beyond frozen deterministic propagation
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only the frozen {List-3, treewidth<=2 arbitrary-list} terminal union and stop at W1/W2/W3.
